tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page behind everything: the map, every view, every plate. Warm paper by day, navy-charcoal by night.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every outline in the drawing, at the one `hairline` weight. Night is #D6DAE0 at 70%. Meets 3:1 on `ground`, `paper` and every tone in both themes. Not for text: use `ink`.

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Live data, and nothing else: levels, needles, floats, tide-gauge pens. Every brass part carries an engraved scale and a `line` outline. Never text, never decoration. Day brass on `ground` is 2.8:1, so the outline carries the edge.

tokens.name: steel
tokens.usage: Default market machinery where an island's tradition doesn't say otherwise; the volume trace on a tide gauge's paper. Not for text.

tokens.name: water
tokens.usage: Liquidity: the liquid in tanks and trays, harbours and the sea. Always a fill inside a `line` outline.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Value moving, or waiting on you to move it. Exactly one orange part per frame, and the approval flag. Never text, never a landmark, an agent or a float. Day accent on `ground` is 2.9:1, so it is always outlined in `line`.

tokens.name: blueprint
tokens.usage: Proposed, unbuilt or being cast: new markets arriving, designs under review, a stall cooling in the foundry. Linework only, never a fill behind text.

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Dead markets and their builds, and wrecks on the low-tide flats. Night rust on `ground` is 2.8:1, so rusted parts keep their `line` outline.

tokens.name: frost
tokens.usage: Freshly cold markets, before they rust. A fill only.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Interface text, the atlas layer's labels, and the stamps and traces on paper. On `ground`, `paper` and tone-0 to tone-3 in both themes (7:1 or better).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary interface text: dates, sources, hints, captions. On `ground` and `paper` only (5.4:1 or better in both themes); never on a tone.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The one paper material: tide-gauge drums, notes, receipts, tide tables and plates. Barely lifts off `ground`, so a paper surface always has a `line` hairline edge.

tokens.name: engraving
tokens.usage: Marks engraved into `brass`: scale ticks, graduation lines, scribed alert marks. Dark in both themes (4.2:1 on day brass, 7.8:1 on night brass). Only ever on brass.

tokens.name: tone-0
tokens.usage: Shading: faces turned furthest from the light. Fills inside `line` outlines; `ink` reads on it.

tokens.name: tone-1
tokens.usage: Shading: the darker side face; also ruled lines on `paper`.

tokens.name: tone-2
tokens.usage: Shading: the lighter side face.

tokens.name: tone-3
tokens.usage: Shading: top faces, always the lightest.

groups.name: Atlas
groups.note: An engraved serif for the atlas layer and plates. Labels are set in letterspaced small caps (font-variant-caps: all-small-caps).

styles.name: atlas-island
styles.usage: Island names, read from the farthest zoom. Small caps.

styles.name: atlas-district
styles.usage: District names in the middle distance, and the path of scales' place corner. Small caps.

styles.name: atlas-token
styles.usage: Token and works names up close. Small caps.

styles.name: plate-title
styles.usage: A plate's title, in sentence case.

groups.name: Readouts
groups.note: The system monospace, for every number the Floor shows. Numbers live here, never in the drawing.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: The live readout in a view's corner.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Receipts, ledgers, transactions, plate numbers and dates.

styles.name: readout-sm
styles.usage: Sources under a note, and fine print on receipts.

groups.name: Notes
groups.note: A typewriter face for what agents write. Seeing it means an agent said this.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: One wallet added most of this pool's liquidity two hours ago.
styles.usage: Notes, theses and briefs: anything an agent wrote.

styles.name: note-sm
styles.sample: Thesis: thin above the price; next large buy moves it far.
styles.usage: A thesis quoted on a receipt, and pins seen at a distance.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: A plain, quiet grotesque for controls and panels.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.usage: Everything else in the interface: mandates, settings, the harbourmaster's answers.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Flag names, field labels, the path of scales, hints.

spacing.note: A 4px base for the interface. The drawing has no spacing scale; it is measured in kit units.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a flag or emblem and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside small controls; between rows of a receipt.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of notes and receipts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the inset of a view's four corners.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a panel; a plate's margin.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between panels; around the drawing on a plate.

radius.note: Square, like a printed plate. The only round things are stamps and pins.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Everything: panels, paper, plates, flags, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-hair
tokens.usage: Text inputs, so they read as controls rather than paper.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Emblem stamps on paper and pins on a machine.

drawing.note: Constants of the drawing itself. The camera and the scales never vary by island or design.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: The one line weight, for every edge in the drawing and every rule in the interface.

tokens.name: camera-pitch
tokens.usage: Orthographic isometric camera, from one corner looking down. No perspective.

tokens.name: tick-pitch
tokens.usage: Minor tick spacing on an engraved scale drawn at interface size.

tokens.name: tick-major-every
tokens.usage: Every fifth tick on an engraved scale is a major mark. No numbers on any scale.
